name: find_events
description: Search campus events. Highlights the matching buildings on the map and returns the matches, best first, with their ids.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The student's interests as a few plain words, e.g. "robotics". No food, times, or places.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the time window, ISO 8601 with UTC offset, e.g. 2026-10-10T16:00:00-04:00. Omit to start now.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the time window, ISO 8601 with UTC offset. Omit when the student gave no limit.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: One of: academic, social, career, sports, arts, club, food, other.

parameters.name: freeFood
parameters.description: "prefer" to rank events with free food higher, "require" to return only those.

parameters.name: nearBuildingName
parameters.description: A building the student mentioned, in their words, e.g. "the library".

name: focus_event
description: Fly the map to an event's building and open it. Use an id returned by find_events.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The id of the event, exactly as find_events returned it.
